# togetherai_gpu_cluster (Resource)

A Together AI GPU cluster (Instant Cluster) running Kubernetes or Slurm.

Create waits until the cluster status is `Ready`, which usually takes 10 minutes to an hour, and then exports the admin `kube_config`. Every cluster needs a shared volume: attach an existing one with `volume_id`, or create one with the cluster with `shared_volume`. Prefer `shared_volume` for a new volume, because a volume created on its own may land in a datacenter that does not have your GPU type.

**Cost:** an on-demand cluster bills per GPU hour from creation until it is deleted (for example 8 x H100 at $3.99 = about $32 per hour). Reserved clusters are charged for the whole reservation up front and cannot be refunded.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "togetherai_gpu_cluster_regions" "all" {}

locals {
  # The first region that offers H100s, and its newest driver catalog entry.
  region = [for r in data.togetherai_gpu_cluster_regions.all.regions : r if contains(r.supported_instance_types, "H100_SXM")][0]
}

resource "togetherai_gpu_cluster" "training" {
  name              = "training"
  cluster_type      = "KUBERNETES"
  region            = local.region.name
  gpu_type          = "H100_SXM"
  billing_type      = "ON_DEMAND"
  num_gpus          = 8
  nvidia_version_id = local.region.driver_versions[0].id

  # Create the shared volume with the cluster so it lands in the same datacenter.
  shared_volume = {
    name     = "training-data"
    size_tib = 1
  }

  timeouts = {
    create = "90m"
  }
}

output "kubeconfig" {
  value     = togetherai_gpu_cluster.training.kube_config
  sensitive = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `billing_type` (String) `ON_DEMAND`, `RESERVED` (set `duration_days`) or `SCHEDULED_CAPACITY` (set `capacity_pool_id` and the reservation times). Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `gpu_type` (String) GPU type. One of `H100_SXM`, `H200_SXM`, `RTX_6000_PCI`, `L40_PCIE`, `B200_SXM`, `H100_SXM_INF`, `B300_SXM`, `GB200_NVL`. Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `name` (String) Cluster name (`cluster_name`). Changing it replaces the cluster.
- `num_gpus` (Number) Number of standard (non-preemptible) GPUs, a multiple of 8 and at least 8. Updated in place (scale up or down); it cannot go below `num_reserved_gpus`. With `auto_scale = true` the autoscaler owns the GPU count: this is the lower bound, the provider does not report the live count as drift, and changing it is rejected.
- `region` (String) Region, such as `us-central-8`. See the `togetherai_gpu_cluster_regions` data source. Changing it replaces the cluster.

### Optional

- `auto_scale` (Boolean) Enable the Kubernetes cluster autoscaler between `num_gpus` and `auto_scale_max_gpus`. It cannot be turned on or off after create.
- `auto_scale_max_gpus` (Number) Maximum GPUs for the autoscaler, a multiple of 8 and at least `num_gpus`. Create-only.
- `capacity_pool_id` (String) Capacity pool for `SCHEDULED_CAPACITY` billing. Create-only.
- `cluster_type` (String) `KUBERNETES` or `SLURM`. The API picks the default when it is not set. Updated in place.
- `cuda_version` (String) Legacy CUDA selector, such as `12.8`. Must be set together with `nvidia_driver_version`. Computed from `nvidia_version_id` when not set. Create-only.
- `duration_days` (Number) Reservation length in days for `RESERVED` billing. Create-only.
- `install_traefik` (Boolean) Install the Traefik ingress controller (Kubernetes only). Create-only.
- `num_capacity_pool_gpus` (Number) GPUs drawn from the capacity pool, a multiple of 8, not more than `num_gpus`. Updated in place.
- `num_preemptible_gpus` (Number) Target number of discounted preemptible GPUs (`desired_preemptible_gpus`), a multiple of 8. Updated in place. Together fills it asynchronously; see `allocated_preemptible_gpus`.
- `num_reserved_gpus` (Number) Prepaid reserved GPUs (`RESERVED` and `SCHEDULED_CAPACITY` billing). Defaults to `num_gpus` for `RESERVED`. Can only be increased.
- `nvidia_driver_version` (String) Legacy NVIDIA driver selector, such as `570`. Must be set together with `cuda_version`. Create-only.
- `nvidia_version_id` (String) Region-specific NVIDIA catalog ID (`driver_versions[*].id` in `togetherai_gpu_cluster_regions`). Set this, or `cuda_version` with `nvidia_driver_version`. Create-only.
- `oidc_config` (Attributes) OIDC authentication for the cluster's Kubernetes API. Create-only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc_config))
- `project_id` (String) Project that owns the cluster. Defaults to the API key's project. Create-only.
- `reservation_end_time` (String) RFC 3339 end of the reservation. Updated in place for prepaid clusters.
- `reservation_start_time` (String) RFC 3339 start of a scheduled reservation. Create-only.
- `shared_volume` (Attributes) Create a shared volume with the cluster, in the cluster's region. Create-only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shared_volume))
- `slurm_image` (String) Custom Slurm image. Create-only.
- `slurm_shm_size_gib` (Number) Shared memory size in GiB. Required when `cluster_type = "SLURM"`. Create-only.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `volume_id` (String) ID of an existing shared volume to attach. Exactly one of `volume_id` and `shared_volume` must be set. With `shared_volume`, this is the ID of the volume created with the cluster. The volume cannot be swapped on an existing cluster.

### Read-Only

- `allocated_preemptible_gpus` (Number) Preemptible GPUs allocated now.
- `control_plane_nodes` (Attributes List) Control plane nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--control_plane_nodes))
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `current_num_gpus` (Number) Standard GPU count the API reports now. Differs from `num_gpus` while the autoscaler has scaled the cluster.
- `duration_hours` (Number) Reservation length in hours, as reported by the API.
- `gpu_worker_nodes` (Attributes List) GPU worker nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gpu_worker_nodes))
- `id` (String) Cluster ID (`cluster_id`).
- `kube_config` (String, Sensitive) Admin kubeconfig (YAML) once the cluster is ready. The API only returns it to a project admin's key; otherwise it is null.
- `status` (String) Cluster status, such as `Ready` or `Degraded`.
- `volumes` (Attributes List) Shared volumes attached to the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes))

<a id="nestedatt--oidc_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc_config`

Required:

- `client_id` (String) OIDC client ID.
- `group_claim` (String) JWT claim with the user's groups, such as `groups`.
- `group_prefix` (String) Prefix added to group names, such as `oidc:`.
- `issuer_url` (String) OIDC issuer URL, such as `https://accounts.google.com`.
- `username_claim` (String) JWT claim used as the username, such as `email`.
- `username_prefix` (String) Prefix added to the username, such as `oidc:`.

Optional:

- `ca_cert` (String) PEM CA certificate of the issuer, for a private CA.


<a id="nestedatt--shared_volume"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shared_volume`

Required:

- `name` (String) Volume name: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and dots, up to 44 characters.
- `size_tib` (Number) Size in whole TiB.

Optional:

- `is_lifecycle_independent` (Boolean) When true, the volume is kept (and keeps billing) after the cluster is deleted.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--control_plane_nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `control_plane_nodes`

Read-Only:

- `host_name` (String) Host name.
- `node_id` (String) Node ID.
- `num_gpus` (Number) GPUs on the node (0 for control plane nodes).
- `public_ipv4` (String) Public IPv4 address, when the node has one.
- `status` (String) Node status.


<a id="nestedatt--gpu_worker_nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gpu_worker_nodes`

Read-Only:

- `host_name` (String) Host name.
- `node_id` (String) Node ID.
- `num_gpus` (Number) GPUs on the node (0 for control plane nodes).
- `public_ipv4` (String) Public IPv4 address, when the node has one.
- `status` (String) Node status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a GPU cluster by its cluster ID.
terraform import togetherai_gpu_cluster.training <cluster_id>
```
